forecast.vintage: OBR Economic and fiscal outlook, October 2026 (Annex A, Tables A.1 and A.3), applied over policyengine-uk's March 2026 growth rates by src/uk_budget_data/forecast/obr_october_2026.json

calibration.source: the certified dataset pinned by the installed policyengine bundle: Microcosm UK from policyengine 6.10.1, policyengine-uk-data before it
calibration.vintage: as pinned by the installed bundle

notes: The forecast is rebased on the Budget's OBR forecast: every simulation, baseline and reform alike, is built on the October 2026 growth rates in src/uk_budget_data/forecast/obr_october_2026.json (CPI, RPI, average earnings, house prices; the September 2027 CPI gap). Series that file does not list keep the March 2026 path the installed policyengine-uk ships; the receipt records the exact model version.
